name: Area of Effect
description: Increase number of creatures affected or AOE by 50% or 1 zone.

name: Clone
description: You achieve elemental chaos mitosis, creating a duplicate spell.

name: Effortless
description: The spell does +1d6 damage or is easy to cast.

name: Elongate
description: When cast, a weaker copy of the spell bounces to a new target. Any saves to apply/resist the spell's effects become one step easier per bounce. Damage or number of creatures affected is reduced by 1 die per bounce. The spell continues until resisted or it fizzles.

name: Facile
description: Once per Long Rest you can cast the spell as a free action.

name: Hardened
description: The save to cast/resist is made with ADV/DISADV.

name: New Flavor
description: The spell changes elements or orientations. Light can be cast as darkness, charm person as frenzy, frost wave can do acid damage, etc.

name: Recyclable
description: 3-in-6 chance of the spell immediately returning to its spellbook for reuse.
